newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebels to release 20 more hostages - Red Cross.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebels to release 20 more hostages - Red Cross.

text.p: The Marxist rebels holding hostages at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima are set to release 20 more hostages, Michel Minnig of the Red Cross, the official mediator in the crisis, said on Saturday.
The announcement came immediately after the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels released three of their VIP hostages.

The three hostages released before the announcement were the Dominican Republic ambassador, Jose Diaz, the president of the Peruvian Association of Exporters, Enrique Pendavis, and the Malaysian ambassador, Ahmad Mokhtar, Minnig said.

The announcement of the release followed the first face-to-face contact between the rebels and a government negotiator after Peru's chief mediator, Education Minister Domingo Palermo, spent three hours and 15 minutes inside the compound earlier on Saturday.
